variants.name: Классический мультяшный
variants.style: OPTION 1 — CLASSIC HEROIC KINGDOM RUSH: compact friendly-heroic proportions with slightly large expressive heads, rounded forms BUILT FROM COARSE PIXEL CLUSTERS, bold clean contours. Gerald has a broad simple cheek-guard helmet silhouette, blue plume swept in one strong arc, readable confident posture; Alleria has a flowing curved ponytail and a large simple triangular cape; Magnus has a proud diamond-shaped ivory collar and a neatly pointed goatee. Orc has a wide flat brow and projecting tusked jaw; goblins have wide ears and cheeky toothy grins. Bright but controlled cobalt/forest-green/plum accents. Keep every figure small; friendliness comes from shape, not more pixels or smoothness.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one full isometric tactical battlefield concept, landscape 1536x1024.
Edit the attached image into one additional character-design variation. The user wants FIVE further options around this latest successful direction: recognizable Kingdom Rush characters drawn as small coarse pixel sprites that match the tiles. This call produces ONE of those options, described below.
LOCK THE WORLD: preserve the floating diamond board, exact square-grid composition, all tile shapes, the green/sand/gray-stone distribution, blue stream paths, exposed vertical block sides, tiny plants, plum background, framing and isometric camera. Do not reimagine terrain to match the characters. Change ONLY the SIX CHARACTERS.
Keep SIX units in the same positions and same small footprints: Sir Gerald Lightseeker lower/left-middle, Alleria Swiftwind upper left, Magnus Spellbane lower left; green helmeted axe orc upper right and two little green goblins at middle right and lower right. Three heroes versus three enemies. No added characters, creatures or props. Figures must be NO LARGER than in the attachment. They remain around one tile-face high; silhouettes and weapons should fit comfortably within a single tile region without hiding the terrain.
IDENTITY INVARIANTS: Gerald = silver knight, cobalt blue swept plume and cloth/cape, plain shield, short sword, minimal gold accents. Alleria = blonde high ponytail, small elf ears, green ranger tunic/cape, brown bow and quiver. Magnus = upright dark hair and small goatee, purple robe, raised ivory/gold collar, simple violet chest gem, gold staff with small flat violet orb; no wizard hat/white beard. Orc = broad green jaw, tiny tusks, iron helmet and axe, brown outfit/armor. Goblins = green faces, large triangular ears, pointed noses, brown clothes, short simple knives.
PIXEL STYLE IS CRITICAL: retain the reference's bold square clusters, obvious coarse staircase edges, dark plum/brown pixel contours and 2-3 flat tones per material. Match characters to the tile pixel density and limited detail. Express personality through a few pixels, silhouette and pose. No tiny decorative trim, rivets, individual fingers or hair strands. Faces have small clear brow/eye/mouth marks, no detailed portrait modeling.
No smooth vector linework, antialiasing, fine dense pixel rendering, 3D/painted miniatures, blur, dither, noise, gradients, glossy shading, magic particles, bloom, flames, oval shadow disks, huge weapons, enlarged figures, HUD, text, labels, logo, watermark or split panels. Maintain simple flat grounded shadows.
The variation below must be visibly distinct in character SHAPE and design, not just a tiny color shift, while remaining in the SAME pixel art family and keeping the board unchanged. Deliver a complete single scene.

variants.name: Угловатый и строгий
variants.style: OPTION 2 — ANGULAR VETERANS: noticeably angular wedge-shaped silhouettes, squared armored shoulders and sharper compact heads, stern pixel expressions. Gerald has a narrow T-visor and faceted flat shoulder guards; Alleria has a strongly triangular backward ponytail/cape silhouette and focused forward stance; Magnus has an angular high V-collar and a straight tapering robe with a strong single spiked hair mass. The orc's jaw and axe are blunt rectangular blocks; goblins have sharp long ears and low hunched silhouettes. Dark aubergine contours, restrained steel/blue/olive/purple palette, no extra decorative detail. Use large jagged pixel clusters, never fine ink. Small sprite size is unchanged.

variants.name: Крепкие фигурки
variants.style: OPTION 3 — STOUT, BROAD COMPACT FIGURES: a noticeably wider, lower center of gravity at the SAME maximum height, short legs, heavy simple hands and boots, bold readable gear. The orc looks like a small solid boulder with a broad face, goblins are squat with oversized sideways ears. Use three broad flat tones and coarse dark contours. Avoid making the units bigger overall: wider forms must be offset by slightly shorter height.

variants.name: Подвижные силуэты
variants.style: OPTION 4 — AGILE THREE-QUARTER STANCES: slimmer compact bodies and clear ready-for-action poses, SAME height and occupied tiles. Heroes face slightly diagonally right toward enemies; enemies angle left. Gerald holds a small kite-like shield forward and sword diagonally ready; Alleria stands side-on with bent knees, bow held forward and ponytail streaming backward; Magnus angles his body and holds the staff close while his other hand is a simple open pixel cluster. Orc leans into his axe grip; goblins hunch forward in different small ready poses. Distinct silhouette gaps, narrow capes and few pixels for expressions; no action effects, no big motion, no change in feet positions, no increased detail.

variants.name: Мягкий цветной контур
variants.style: OPTION 5 — HARMONIZED STORYBOOK PIXELS: locally colored contours instead of near-black outlines (slate for armor, deep olive for green, aubergine for purple, warm umber for leather), calmer lower-contrast palette that belongs to the tile world. Still clearly coarse pixel art with hard staircase edges, no soft gradients. Compact gently rounded heads, broad clean shadow shapes, simple gentle facial expressions for heroes; impish smirks on goblins and a gruff orc. Gerald's silhouette emphasizes a blue cape and short plume; Alleria's ponytail forms a simple round loop shape; Magnus's collar is two broad ivory planes over a tidy narrow robe. Shapes visibly simplified and less busy than the base, without losing distinctive Kingdom Rush cues. No glow or microdetails.
